title: docs(skills): teach that a notify with no link opens the run's trigger record
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D8rNJVDBGUc9LuK6RAGm4BT)_

Fixes #30254

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:自动化技能的 notify 示例、flows 文档的 notify 段落、一条新 eval,改教「不写链接时,通知点开就是触发这次运行的那条记录」。
- 为什么改:PR #30252 已让运行时这样做,技能和文档还在教旧规则「不写成对的 sourceObject/sourceId 就没有链接」,AI 会白写一对多余的键。
- 风险与回滚:只改教学文字和 eval,不改任何代码或 schema;回滚即整体 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 notify 示例三行(L124–126),其次 `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 约 L351 的段落。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,应看到 objectstack-automation/SKILL.md 为 6447 tokens(上限 6449)。
- 需要你做的:受管面(`skills/**`,Tier H),请审阅后批准或合并。

## What changes

The runtime default that PR #30252 landed, read off `origin/main` `b77c160a` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`, `defaultClickThroughOf` and the `sourceObject` / `sourceId` / `actionUrl` config-schema descriptions): a `notify` node that writes none of `sourceObject`, `sourceId` and `actionUrl` links to the run's trigger record when the run has one (a record change other than a delete, a time-relative sweep's row, an action started on a record). An explicit pair or `actionUrl` wins; a half-written pair is dropped, never defaulted; a run with no trigger record links nowhere.

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: the notify example's link comments now state the default and its three exceptions (`link: PAIR, else dropped; none of the 3 ⇒ the trigger record (not on delete), if any`; `actionUrl` overrides the pair). The old `// click-through: a PAIR, else dropped` is gone.
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: the notify `sourceId` paragraph states the default, its three cases, and the three exceptions, with the no-trigger-record examples the code comment names (a schedule tick, an inbound API post, a manual start with no record).
- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`: eval 14, a record-triggered notify that should open its case. It expects no `sourceObject:` / `actionUrl:` written and the words `trigger record` (taught in SKILL.md).
- `.changeset/30254-notify-default-link-skill.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

| all `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines | 4534 | 4534 |

The new notify comment costs 13 bytes net inside the example (it also drops the `(a value slot)` and `text slot;` asides, which Valid-but-silently-wrong item 1 teaches for `sourceId` and `actionUrl`). It is paid inside the same file by deleting a duplicated aside from the Flow Types `api` row, `or a literal secret;`: the Inbound webhook config table still teaches `secretRef` / `secret`. No ceiling moved.

## Tests

Teaching text and an eval only; no code changed, so no unit suite and no ablation apply. The gate readings are under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- Card item 3 is not in this PR (spec lane, out of this file surface). On `origin/main` `b77c160a`, `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` still carries the old rule: the `sourceObject` (L750) and `sourceId` (L756) `.describe()` texts say only that a half pair is dropped, and the `actionUrl` text says only that it overrides the synthesized link. None of the three mentions the trigger-record default. The generated `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx` (L106, L107, L109) repeats them. The seat carries this to `domain:spec`.
- The SKILL.md ceiling is left at 6449 (headroom 2): lowering it is a `scripts/` edit outside this file surface.
